```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
  issue:
    types: [opened, edited, labeled, unlabeled, assigned, unassigned, closed, reopened]

jobs:
  claude:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      checks: write
      discussions: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Run Claude Code
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          assignee_trigger: "claude"
          label_trigger: "claude"
          base_branch: "main"
          branch_prefix: "claude"
          branch_name_template: "claude-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}"
          allowed_bots: "claude-code-action"
          allowed_non_write_users: "none"
          include_comments_by_actor: "true"
          exclude_comments_by_actor: "claude-code-action"
          prompt: ""
          settings: ""
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          anthropic_federation_rule_id: ""
```
